observations: Front view of a bicycle-style bike with handlebars, a headlight fairing, a front wire basket, and a front wheel/tire.
Photo is taken at a steep angle showing only the front half of the bike; no rear wheel, hub, motor, or controller is visible.
No battery pack, charger, display screen, or throttle is visible anywhere in the frame.
A watermark reads 'SAINT PAUL ENTERPRISE' (photo 0) which appears to be the seller/shop name, not a brand on the item.
Background shows a tiled floor, a gate, and a wooden shelf; no other identifying marks or labels on the bike itself.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows only a front view with handlebars, headlight, and basket; no motor hub, controller, or electric drivetrain component is visible to confirm it is electric rather than a standard bicycle.
No battery pack or charger appears anywhere in photo 0; nothing to inspect or confirm voltage or inclusion.

risks.risk: Item may actually be a standard non-electric bicycle fitted with a headlight/basket, not a true e-bike.
risks.proof: A photo showing the rear wheel/hub motor, mid-drive motor, or any wiring/controller box.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a standard non-electric bicycle, not an e-bike

risks.risk: Battery and charger claimed but not shown; may be missing, damaged, or wrong voltage.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual battery pack (with label showing voltage/Ah) and the charger together with the bike.
risks.if_unproven: priced as bike only, without battery or charger

risks.risk: Overall frame condition (rust, dents, rear wheel condition, brakes) cannot be judged from a single front-angle shot.
risks.proof: Full side view and rear view photos of the bike.
risks.if_unproven: priced as average/unknown condition, assume needs servicing

risks.risk: No proof the bike powers on or that any electric assist functions.
risks.proof: A short video of the bike's throttle/pedal-assist engaging and the wheel turning under power.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working/non-functional electric system

proof_requests: Photo of the rear wheel showing a hub motor (or mid-drive motor) and wiring.
Photo of the battery pack and charger together with visible labels (voltage/Ah).
A short video showing the bike powering on and moving under electric power.
Full side and rear photos of the bike for condition assessment.
response.reason: The single front-angle photo shows no motor, battery, charger, or any electric component, so it cannot be confirmed this is actually an electric bike rather than a plain bicycle with a basket and headlight; this is a category-defining fact, not just a condition detail, so no worst-case price can be set without further proof.
